films.line_mk: Вашиот партнер за секој нов чекор.
films.line_en: Your partner for every new step.
films.desc_en: A local bakery owner expands her business with the help of flexible financing.
films.music: Upbeat acoustic indie folk, acoustic guitar, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Но, за раст е потребна поддршка.
Ние сме тука за вашиот бизнис.
Остварете ги вашите цели со нас.
Вашиот партнер за секој нов чекор.

shots.kf: 35-year-old woman, curly brown hair, dark green linen shirt and apron, standing in a dim rustic bakery in Skopje Old Bazaar. Morning light streaming through a small window. Medium shot, 50mm lens, warm earthy color palette, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
shots.motion: The woman slowly pushes a small mound of white flour across the wooden table. Slow camera push in.

shots.kf: 35-year-old woman, curly brown hair, dark green linen shirt and apron, holding a sleek glowing blue blank card. Soft diffused indoor lighting. Medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm earthy colors with a blue accent, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman gently tilts the glowing blue card to catch the ambient light. Slow, smooth camera pan right.

shots.kf: A sleek glowing blue blank bank card resting on a rustic wooden table next to a sprig of wheat. Soft overhead lighting. Close-up, macro lens, shallow depth of field, rich warm brown and vibrant blue color palette, photorealistic, highly detailed.
shots.motion: The glowing card pulses slightly with soft light while a dust mote drifts by. Subtle camera zoom in.

shots.kf: 35-year-old woman, curly brown hair, dark green linen shirt and apron, hanging a new vintage copper lamp in a brightly lit, modern bakery interior. Sunlight fills the room. Medium wide shot, 35mm lens, warm and bright color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman gently adjusts the copper lamp, making it sway slightly in the air. Slow camera pedestal up.

shots.kf: 35-year-old woman, curly brown hair, dark green linen shirt and apron, standing proudly outside a bakery store. Blurred traditional Skopje architecture with stone walls behind her. Bright midday sun casting soft shadows. Medium shot, 50mm lens, vibrant warm colors, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman turns her head slightly to look into the distance while smiling warmly. Slow camera pull back.

films.line_en: The key to your new home.
films.desc_en: A young man moves into his first apartment in Skopje through an accessible home loan.
films.music: Hopeful ambient pop, piano and soft strings, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Сонот за сопствен дом е реален.
Брзо и лесно одобрување на кредит.

shots.kf: 30-year-old man, short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and grey cardigan, standing in an empty modern apartment. Large window showing Mount Vodno in the background. Overcast soft daylight. Medium shot, 35mm lens, cool grey and white color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The man walks slowly towards the large glass window to look at the mountain. Slow camera tracking forward.

shots.kf: 30-year-old man, short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and grey cardigan, looking down at an abstract silver house key in his palm. Soft window light. Medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, cool tones, photorealistic, cinematic.
shots.motion: The man slowly closes his fingers over the silver key in a gentle motion. Static camera, slow zoom.

shots.kf: Abstract silver house key resting on a pristine white marble kitchen counter. Soft directional light creating a long shadow. Close-up, macro lens, shallow depth of field, minimalist white and silver color palette, photorealistic, elegant and highly detailed.
shots.motion: A subtle glimmer of light reflects off the edge of the silver key. Smooth slow camera pan left.

shots.kf: 30-year-old man, short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and grey cardigan, placing a vibrant green potted plant onto a minimalist wooden shelf in the sunny apartment. Medium shot, 50mm lens, bright airy color palette with green accents, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The man gently sets the ceramic pot on the wooden shelf and adjusts the leaves. Slow camera tilt down.

shots.kf: 30-year-old man, short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and grey cardigan, sitting and relaxing on a new modern yellow sofa in the living room. Warm afternoon sunlight. Medium wide shot, 35mm lens, cozy and warm color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The man leans back into the yellow sofa and takes a deep, relaxing breath. Slow camera pull back.

films.desc_en: A fast-paced social media ad demonstrating the ease of mobile payments at a cafe.
films.music: Energetic electronic dance beat, punchy bass, 128 bpm
vo_mk: Твојот телефон е твојот нов паричник. Плати брзо!

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. Close up of a sleek blank smartphone hovering over a black digital payment terminal. Blurred modern Skopje cafe in the background. Warm moody indoor lighting. 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, rich dark tones with amber highlights, photorealistic, no text.
shots.motion: The sleek smartphone slowly lowers towards the surface of the black payment terminal. Smooth, slow camera push in.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. A barista in a black apron sliding a white ceramic coffee cup across a polished wooden counter. Warm cafe lighting, soft shadows. Medium close-up, 50mm lens, cozy amber and dark brown color palette, photorealistic, highly detailed.
shots.motion: The barista's arm smoothly slides the ceramic cup across the wooden counter. Slow camera pan following the cup.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 composition. A person in a stylish beige trench coat walking away down a sunny Skopje street, holding a white coffee cup. Morning sunlight creating long beautiful shadows. Medium wide shot, 35mm lens, bright airy color palette, photorealistic, cinematic.
shots.motion: The person walks steadily away from the lens down the sunlit street. Slow smooth camera tilt up.

films.line_mk: Едноставно, сигурно, секогаш тука за вас.
films.line_en: Simple, secure, always here for you.
films.desc_en: An explainer video detailing the premium advisory services and digital tools for clients.
films.music: Corporate tech ambient, soft marimba and synth, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Вашите финансии бараат сигурност и професионален совет во секое време.
Нашите советници ви нудат персонализиран пристап за вашите уникатни потреби.
Управувајте со вашите сметки преку нашата модерна дигитална платформа.
Следете го вашиот напредок со напредни алатки за анализа на трошоци.
Едноставно, сигурно, секогаш тука за вас.

shots.kf: Sleek glass doors opening to a modern, sunlit bank branch interior in Skopje. Abstract geometric interior design with luxurious seating. Soft morning sunlight streaming through large windows. Wide shot, 24mm lens, clean white and subtle navy blue color palette, photorealistic, cinematic architecture.
shots.motion: The sleek glass doors slowly slide open to reveal the bright bank interior. Slow camera push forward.

shots.kf: A branch adviser in a tailored navy blue suit sitting at a pristine minimalist desk, gesturing gently with an open hand. Soft diffused office lighting. Medium shot, 50mm lens, professional and elegant blue and grey color palette, photorealistic, shallow depth of field.
shots.motion: The adviser softly moves his hand in a welcoming gesture across the desk. Slow camera pan right.

shots.kf: An abstract blank smartphone screen glowing with a soft blue gradient, lying flat on a dark polished oak desk. Ambient light reflecting off the screen surface. Close-up, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, deep brown and glowing blue color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The blue gradient on the blank screen shifts softly as ambient light reflects. Slow camera hover above.

shots.kf: A premium black leather wallet and a sleek metallic blank bank card resting on a polished wooden table. Elegant soft spotlight from above. Close-up, 85mm lens, rich dark brown and metallic silver color palette, photorealistic, highly detailed.
shots.motion: A subtle glint of light travels across the edge of the metallic bank card. Slow camera tracking left.

shots.kf: A hand carefully pouring steaming black coffee from a silver pot into an elegant white porcelain cup in a modern VIP lounge. Warm background lighting. Medium close-up, 50mm lens, warm amber and crisp white color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The dark coffee streams smoothly into the porcelain cup, steam rising softly. Static camera with slow zoom in.

shots.kf: Abstract blurry city traffic of Skopje seen through a large spotless glass window of a high-rise office. Beautiful golden hour sunset lighting hitting the glass. Medium wide shot, 35mm lens, warm orange and cool blue color palette, photorealistic, cinematic mood.
shots.motion: The blurry lights of the city cars move fluidly in the background. Slow camera tilt down.

shots.kf: A clean modern office desk setup with a glowing blank tablet and a small vibrant green potted bonsai tree. Soft daylight illuminating the scene. Medium shot, 50mm lens, minimalist white, grey, and green color palette, photorealistic, highly detailed.
shots.motion: The leaves of the bonsai tree rustle very slightly in a gentle breeze. Slow camera pull back.

films.desc_en: A cinematic and emotional brand story about passing down wealth and values to the next generation.
films.music: Emotional cinematic orchestral, slow cello and piano, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Времето е највредното нешто што го имаме.
Зачувајте го за оние кои најмногу значат.

shots.kf: An older man with distinguished silver hair, wearing a thick wool sweater, walking slowly along the rocky edge of Lake Matka. Golden hour sunlight filtering through the trees. Medium wide shot, 35mm lens, warm golden and deep green color palette, photorealistic, highly cinematic.
shots.motion: The older man takes slow, deliberate steps along the rocky path near the water. Slow camera tracking right.

shots.kf: A vintage gold pocket watch resting on a mossy grey rock near the edge of the lake. Soft golden sunlight catching the polished metal casing. Extreme close-up, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, earthy green and metallic gold color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sunlight shimmers gently across the surface of the gold pocket watch. Slow smooth camera push in.

shots.kf: A traditional wooden boat gently resting on the calm turquoise water of Lake Matka. Majestic canyon walls rising in the blurred background. Golden evening light. Wide shot, 24mm lens, vibrant turquoise, warm brown and grey color palette, photorealistic, peaceful atmosphere.
shots.motion: The wooden boat bobs very softly on the gentle ripples of the lake. Slow camera pan left.

shots.kf: The older man with silver hair gently placing his wrinkled hand on the shoulder of a young boy wearing a blue jacket. Soft warm sunlight illuminating their backs. Medium close-up, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm and nostalgic color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The older man gives the young boy's shoulder a gentle, reassuring squeeze. Slow camera pedestal up.

shots.kf: A young boy in a blue jacket standing at the edge of the lake, his arm outstretched after throwing a flat stone. The water surface is smooth and reflective. Medium shot, 50mm lens, cool blue and warm golden color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The boy lowers his arm slowly while watching the ripples on the water surface. Slow camera tracking forward.

shots.kf: Wide landscape shot of the sun setting behind the majestic Matka Canyon mountains in North Macedonia. The sky is painted with vivid orange, pink, and deep purple hues. The lake reflects the sky perfectly. Ultra wide shot, 16mm lens, vibrant sunset color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The soft evening mist drifts slowly across the surface of the glowing lake. Extremely slow camera pull back.
